transport_rules.callbacks: Observer refuse before logging/start/send; truthy refusal throws Error. onStart receives string body otherwise null. onEnd receives terminal HTTP outcome or transport error. WorkspaceIndex loads schema-compatible local meta or resets. Bootstrap fetches manifest unless resuming progress, rejects over budget, snapshots 200/page until done, persists resumable afterNumber and original cursor then changes 500/page until has_more false. Reloads if another context advances cursor. Uses lock, coalesced rerun, 2s debounce and 5min polling. onChange only broadcasts serving. dispose clears timers/engine and optionally destroys store. Search reads local records and snippets; no per-hit API hydration. Budget 500MiB, recheck 24h. 410 resets and immediate retry; 403/404 reset and unavailable for 1h; other errors incl network/503/no tab/schema/IDB back off 5s exponential capped 5min times jitter 0.5..1.5. Failed catchup can serve last good copy for <10min; otherwise fallback. Too-large reset errors swallowed; no fabricated empty sync pages.
Non-.test source included: FakeServer fixtures and in-memory log implementation of IndexFetcher; manifest/snapshot/changes are local fake methods, not production network.
